use_case: Use the intake form during business service quote development and approval when the service quote record must identify prospect, service package, locations, volumes, delivery window, assumptions, pricing inputs, and quote validity. Complete the applicable handoff for approved quote version, customer delivery, acceptance status, expiry follow-up, CRM update, and contract handoff.
